scope: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL and UD-Q8_K_XL; DFlash2 Q4_K_M and AR; ROCm 7.2.3; Nix release; performance profile
localChanges: Added snapshot/long-prefill tests and target fingerprint mode; corrected the image-retry fixture; limited Qwen persistent-snapshot clearing to headers. Model arithmetic, payload bytes and disk formats are unchanged. Initial controls use the original rebased PR binary; cleanup revalidation and refreshed tables use the fixed binary.

quality.limit: Execution consistency against main; does not newly qualify original-model or GGUF-conversion accuracy.

pairedPerformance.method: One warmed sample, same binary toolchain/model/flags/cache history. Single-user pp2048/tg128 at depths 0/8192; prepared pp2048 concurrency. Timings flagged above both 5% and 3 ms, per request/phase.

benchmarkMethod: Published concurrency retains the short September corpus and unchanged llama.cpp data. Prepared pp2048 review controls are separate.

imageRetryFixture.cause: The 8 GiB RAM cache refused a full-prompt checkpoint at 287 tokens; replay correctly reused 280 and prefilled the seven-token assistant opening.
imageRetryFixture.change: Use the existing capacity-refusal guard for image replay. Require the prior request to log refusal at the same prompt boundary, bounded framing prefill, unchanged token accounting, a reused prefix, and unchanged cold/warm/replay output.

q4-ar: functional-v2-q4-off (all checks except the corrected conversation fixture)
image-pr-fixed-history (full preceding history and corrected conversation suite)

admissionFinding: Initial C2 client-index pairing was reversed between identical requests. Reverse-order C8 Q4 and C2 Q8 repeats reproduced the admission wait on unchanged main. C4 Q8 with simultaneous admission was faster on candidate (91.52 vs 89.61 tok/s), with smaller maximum token gaps. Admission-dependent latency remains variable; initial flags are retained and are not claimed as uniformly passing timings.

cacheCleanup.change: Qwen target, serving wrapper and DFlash2 serializers clear only headers. Nested serializers and copies overwrite the entire payload. Sentinel tests compare full serialized bytes from differently prefilled destinations; reserved fields remain zero.

profiler.finding: Added stream synchronization is too small to explain the snapshot gap; keep it for correctness. Allocation/copying dominates captures.
